description: This source file contains extension methods and classes related to fault injection storage and testing within the Orleans framework. It defines extension methods to register fault injection storage services, classes for fault injection grain storage implementations, factory methods, options configurations, and related test cluster infrastructure. The file also includes shell classes for silo management, helper utilities, and configurations for Unix socket transport, along with generated code for serialization and deep copying of specific types.
